name: Blades of Chance
desc:
Blades of Chance is a RNG based game where you open chests to unlock some of the rarest blades and show them off to your friends!

🎲 Roll to unlock rare blades!
⚔️  Show off your best swords use them to fight other players in our PvP arena
💎 Fight gremlins for loot drops, complete quests and unlock achievements for special rewards
✨ Beat the boss in the dungeon for rewards
🥇 Be the top on the leaderboards
🍀 Invite your friends for a luck boost!


UPDATE: New environment, new chests, improvements to dungeon, bug fixes & more!

Emotes: /sit1 /sit2 /lean1 /lean2

🤞🏻 Feeling lucky? Join our group for a free luck boost!

👍 Enjoying the game? Let us know by leaving it a like!
